items.name: Crystal Staff
items.notes: A quarter of the mana its bearer spends comes back; the crystal lights the way at night. Two-handed: no shield.

items.name: Orb Staff
items.notes: Its bearer's race special now and then strikes twice. Two-handed: no shield.

items.name: Skull Staff
items.notes: Raises skeletons, as the game's Necromancer's Staff. Two-handed: no shield.

items.name: Flame Staff
items.notes: Its bearer's fire always sets alight what it touches; its blows can too. Two-handed: no shield.

items.name: Nature Staff
items.notes: Its bearer's people close by heal faster, and crops near it ripen faster. Two-handed: no shield.

items.name: Dragon Skull Staff
items.notes: Its blows can set the target alight, and its bearer can't be set alight. Two-handed: no shield.

items.name: Spider Staff
items.notes: Its blows can bind the target in silk, held fast for 3 s. Two-handed: no shield.

items.name: Runeblade
items.station: Gem cutter, beside a powered rune circuit
items.notes: Each hit adds Astral damage. Start from an Iron Longsword.

items.name: Flametongue
items.station: Gem cutter, beside a powered rune circuit
items.notes: Sets the target alight. Start from an Iron Sword.

items.name: Frostbite Axe
items.station: Gem cutter, beside a powered rune circuit
items.notes: Hits slow the target. Start from a Silver Battle Axe.

items.name: Stormcaller Spear
items.station: Gem cutter, beside a powered rune circuit
items.notes: Lightning jumps to a second enemy. Start from a Silver Spear.

items.name: Voidedge
items.station: Gem cutter, beside a powered rune circuit
items.notes: Drinks the life it spills. Start from an Adamantium Scimitar (made by: Dwarf).

items.name: Dawnbringer
items.station: Gem cutter, beside a powered rune circuit
items.notes: Double damage to undead and demons. Start from a Gold Mace.
